reviewFindingRegistry.derivation: exact sorted findingId set in the governed record; callers may not supply or narrow this set
reviewFindingRegistry.acceptanceRule: every exact ID receives one successor-review disposition with evidence/rationale; author response is not reviewer closure; missing, duplicate, unknown, or review-scope-omitted IDs forbid acceptance

sourceAcquisition.authorization: registered structure only; executionState and the combined-freeze gate forbid every request/import now
sourceAcquisition.subjectUniverse: each unique identity-pass effective assessment tip with disposition include-acquire; include-citation-lead is not a source-acquisition subject until a reviewed successor assessment promotes it
sourceAcquisition.locatorDerivation: union exact HTTP(S) full-text, repository, publisher, archive, and source links returned by governing provider records plus exact assessed stable-identifier landing links; normalize without changing origin/path/query meaning, deduplicate by normalized URL, sort by source occurrence rank then URL, retain the first 20
sourceAcquisition.responseDerivedChildRule: from each captured depth-0 landing body, a reviewed link extractor may emit exact HTTP(S) source/full-text links whose relation to the subject is evidenced; deduplicate globally for the subject, sort by parent request ID then document order then normalized URL, retain at most 20 total depth-1 children; depth greater than one is forbidden

requestTemplate.redirectPolicy: transport.redirectPolicy with the source URL's captured origin added only when that exact locator is registered; credentials remain forbidden

sourceAcquisition.manualImportRule: one immutable no-network slot may import bytes already obtained through a registered stable identifier or locator only; it records acquisition actor, UTC, original path/name, stable identifier/URL, media type, byte count and SHA-256; an empty slot must terminate as not-provided and cannot be silently omitted
sourceAcquisition.completionRule: every retained locator, derived child, and the one manual slot has exactly one terminal state; remaining links, excess locators, malformed/cross-policy redirects, or nonterminal members make acquisition incomplete; no metadata occurrence is primary-admissible until acquired readable bytes, complete inventory, evidence segments and language review close
sourceAcquisition.searchNegativeRule: a source-negative or bounded-search-negative result requires terminal closure of the full acquisition universe for every include-acquire subject; producer summaries cannot shrink it

recognizedUnmappedUnits.quantitativeEffect: no canonical pressurePa may be emitted and matched-pressure/source-compatibility remains unresolved unless a separately reviewed protocol successor binds an applicable authority, definition, conversion and uncertainty
recognizedUnmappedUnits.rationale: this candidate has no governed authority establishing that the source's applicable millimetres-of-mercury convention is exactly the registered Torr conversion

rejectedUncertaintyOperators.formula: combinedVariance=instrumentStandardUncertaintySquared+sampleVariance/n; uncertainty is the exact symbolic nonnegative sqrt(combinedVariance)
rejectedUncertaintyOperators.denominator: sample component uses n-1 then n
rejectedUncertaintyOperators.censoring: no silent exclusions and both components source-bound
rejectedUncertaintyOperators.reason: its sum of instrument variance and repeat-mean variance silently sets their covariance to zero
